$schema_note: Hand-curated record of the counts the unique picks are checked against, NOT mechanically extracted (see hs-game-sdk/curated/satanic_zone.json for why curated/ exists). Data only: no binding is generated from this file, and hs_game_sdk/unique_pick_model.py never reads it; tests/test_unique_pick_model.py reads both and checks that the model reproduces each entry. The mechanism, in our own words, is docs/models/unique-pick-spec.md, whose notation (T, L_k, D_k, c, e, n, m) the `model` fields use. Every entry has `id`, `kind` (`baseline` = vanilla, nothing pushed; `target` = a ForgePact lever applied; `our_code` = a contract of ForgePact's own code, not the game), `status` (`measured` or `our_code`), `date` (the measurement date; for `our_code` entries, the date the code was read), `source` (a list of {path, section} or {repo, commit}; paths are relative to the hub root, `section` is text that appears in that file), `scripts` (every `gml_Script_*` the entry involves, all bound in hs_game_sdk.scripts.GameScript), `what` (the observation), `values`, `model` (what the model must show) and, once the model's tests exist, exactly one of `reproduced_by` (the dotted id of the test that reproduces it) or `not_reproduced` (why it cannot be). Every #74 count below was made with the Angelic roll's chance raised by a research lever, never at the natural chance; `standinPicks=` is keyed on a stand-in's sub and b (the pair, not the triple), so its vanilla share is m / T. The flight charms' own live counts (UP9 to UP13, #158's Mod live 1 and Mod live 2) cite ForgePact/docs/flight-charms-research.md's Mod live 1 results and Mod live 2 results, where they are recorded; like #74's, they were made with the Angelic roll's chance raised by a research lever, the ordinary unique roll is called by name, and UP11's `flightprobe pool` pins T at 48. The live captures are gitignored and never cited here.

source.section: `standinPicks=1`, so the baseline share p0 is 1/57

measurements.what: #74 Live 1 (list injection, research dll f7560e80...), both switches off and nothing pushed: 59 Angelic rolls gave 57 hits, and 1 of them carried a validated stand-in's sub and b (standinPicks=1).
measurements.model: With nothing pushed, standinPicks= grows at m / T per hit, m being 2 or 3: 1 of 57 lies within the 3-sigma binomial band for some T in 40..60.

source.section: ### 23.8 The ordinary unique roll makes one draw

measurements.what: #74 Live 2's list dump: Controller_obj.lootListUnique is an array of 6 ds_lists of 50, 61, 79, 152, 221 and 380 entries, every entry a triple; the sizes were the same after a zone change and at the end of the session. Only [5] holds Liquor Holster's {8, 0, 51}, once.
measurements.model: The ordinary roll's chance of dropping one entry pushed once onto sub-list k is 1 / (L_k + 1), between 1/51 and 1/222 over these lengths; with c copies it is c / (L_k + c).

source.section: How #74 uses the list: a stand-in entry for the length of the roll.

measurements.what: The push: for the length of one roll ForgePact adds c copies of each switched-on item's stand-in entry to the list that roll reads, and takes them off its tail afterwards. Headhunter, Tyrant's Crown, Gabriel Wings and Witch's Broomstick push onto lootListUnique[5] (the Angelic roll); Pocket Elf pushes onto each of lootListUnique[0..4] (the ordinary unique roll) and adds nothing inside the Angelic roll. c is a constexpr 1 in the player build for both #74 (g_SigCopies) and the flight charms (g_FlightDropCopies); only the research build's copies levers change it, 1 to 400.
measurements.model: As an input transform: an Angelic roll with these items on sees T + e droppable entries, e the sum of c over the items switched on; an ordinary roll with Pocket Elf on sees L_k + c entries on sub-list k. Switched off, nothing is added and the baseline shares are unchanged.

source.section: // The share of a stand-in hit that becomes the charm: c / (n + c).
a candidate is the mod item's with

measurements.what: The coin: a typed hit whose whole triple is a pushed stand-in's goes to the item with probability c / (n + c), n being how many vanilla entries of that list carry the same triple, and otherwise stays the game's own. Pocket Elf's stand-in is chosen so that n is the same on all five sub-lists.
measurements.model: As an input transform: the stand-in triple is kept with (n + c) / (T + e) and the coin gives the item c / (n + c) of that, so each item takes c / (T + e) of the Angelic roll's drops and the stand-in keeps n / (T + e); on the ordinary roll Pocket Elf takes c / (L_k + c). At c = 1 every item takes exactly one entry's share.

source.section: At the research lever's 200 copies, 20 unique-roll calls placed 19 items, 11 of them Pocket Elf
With 200 copies added, 20 calls placed 19 items, 11 of them the added

measurements.what: #158 Mod live 1 (S19, research dll c15f85e1..., Town_01_rm), Pocket Elf's switch on with Aimbot.exe as its stand-in and the research lever pushing 200 copies onto each of lootListUnique[0..4] per call (injected=20000 over 20 calls): 20 by-name calls of the ordinary unique roll placed 19 items, 11 of them Pocket Elf, ours equal to built (elf=11/11), refused=0, anomalies=0. Every hit line read the coin as 200 in 200, so the stand-in's n on the ordinary lists is 0.
measurements.model: With Pocket Elf pushed at c = 200 and n = 0, one call drops it with c / (L_k + c), between 200/421 and 200/250 over the five lengths, whichever list the roll chooses: 11 of 20 lies within the 3-sigma band over that range; the player build's one copy (1/222 to 1/51) and no push (0) are rejected.

source.section: and 21 Wings and 22 Broomsticks of 44, ours equal to built each time

measurements.what: #158 Mod live 1 (S20, research dll c15f85e1..., Act_01_01), Gabriel Wings' and Witch's Broomstick's switches on and 200 copies of each stand-in (Water Melon {10, 0, 47} and Soul Collector {10, 0, 91}) pushed onto lootListUnique[5] per roll, the Angelic roll's chance raised by a research lever: 44 rolls gave 44 hits, 21 of them Gabriel Wings and 22 Witch's Broomstick, ours equal to built, refused=0, anomalies=0 (after 26 hits, 13 of each). The hit lines read the coin as 200 in 201 (n = 1).
measurements.model: With both charms pushed at c = 200 (e = 400) and n = 1, each takes c / (T + e) of the Angelic roll's drops, 200/448 at the measured T of 48: 21 and 22 of 44 each lie within the 3-sigma band; the player build's one copy each (1/50) is rejected.

source.section: The Angelic roll's list held 380 entries, 48 of them

measurements.what: #158 Mod live 2 (`flightprobe pool`, research dll dd87086c..., read in Town_01_rm and again in Act_01_01 before the kills, both readings the same, nothing pushed): lootListUnique[5] held 380 entries, 48 of them droppable by the Angelic roll's tests (counted with repeats), with Water Melon and Soul Collector once each; the ordinary lists [0..4] held 50, 61, 79, 152 and 221 entries, and Pocket Elf's stand-in Aimbot.exe none of them.
measurements.model: T is 48: inside the 40..60 the #74 replays accepted, and every #74 count still fits the band at T = 48; n is 1 for both Angelic stand-ins and 0 for Pocket Elf's on every ordinary list, so the coin hands the flight charms 1 / 2 and 1 of a stand-in hit at c = 1, and each charm takes 1 / (48 + e) of the Angelic roll's drops.

source.section: At one copy, 100 unique-roll calls placed 97 items, one of them Pocket Elf
With one entry added to each sub-list per call, 100 calls placed 97

measurements.what: #158 Mod live 2 (`rate-elf`, research dll dd87086c..., Town_01_rm), Pocket Elf's switch on with Aimbot.exe as its stand-in and the player build's one copy pushed onto each of lootListUnique[0..4] per call (injected=500 over 100 calls): 100 by-name calls of the ordinary unique roll placed 97 items, one of them Pocket Elf, ours equal to built (elf=1/1), refused=0, anomalies=0. Before the switch went on, ten calls placed ten uniques and no Pocket Elf (unique-control).
measurements.model: With Pocket Elf pushed at c = 1 and n = 0, one call drops it with 1 / (L_k + 1), between 1/222 and 1/51: 1 of 100 lies within the 3-sigma band over that range (one entry's share); Mod live 1's 200 copies (200/421 to 200/250) and no push are rejected. At one copy the band is wide: one Pocket Elf in 100 calls cannot tell one entry's share from a share a few times larger or smaller, so this entry rules out only the 200-copy flood and no push at all; it does not pin the rate, and it does not settle whether the index can equal the length (1 / (L_k + 2)).

source.section: 102 Angelic drops (114 rolls), 2 Witch's Broomsticks and no Gabriel Wings

measurements.what: #158 Mod live 2 (`rate-angelic`, research dll dd87086c..., Act_01_01), Gabriel Wings' and Witch's Broomstick's switches on at the player build's one copy each (injected rose by 228 over 114 rolls), Pocket Elf off, the Angelic roll's chance raised by a research lever: 114 rolls gave 102 hits, 2 of them Witch's Broomstick and none Gabriel Wings, ours equal to built (broom=2/2, wings=0/0), refused=0, anomalies=0. The hit lines read the coin as 1 in 2 (n = 1).
measurements.model: With both charms pushed at c = 1 (e = 2), n = 1 and T = 48, each takes 1 / 50 of the Angelic roll's drops (one entry's share): 0 and 2 of 102 both lie within the 3-sigma band, about 0 to 6.3; Mod live 1's 200 copies (200/448) are rejected, and a switch that pushed nothing cannot give the 2 Broomsticks. At one copy the band is wide (about -2.2 to 6.3 hits): these counts cannot tell one entry's share from a share a few times larger or smaller, so this entry rules out only the 200-copy flood and no push at all; it does not pin the rate.
